correctness.rationale: Both structures reduce on injective k-tuples to the same F_2 pair-bit space. The global toggle, cut-space dimensions, small-k exceptions, Stirling transform, and binary-orbital pairing invariant were reconstructed explicitly and the finite quotient counts were exhaustively checked through k=6.

originality.rationale: The classification source states the reduct generators but not the five orbit profiles or their graph/tournament termwise equality. Targeted semantic and exact comparisons found no equivalent or stronger published or indexed claim; the closest own prior result gives only the Rado-graph side.

value.rationale: The result gives a systematic concrete counterexample to reconstruction from complete numerical oligomorphic profiles: matched graph and tournament reducts have identical counts in every arity while the base groups have different binary-orbital pairing and hence are not conjugate.
